title: ‘Queer Eye’ life coach Karamo Brown launches Kē, a wellness app featuring his AI digital clone
brief: Karamo Brown, lifestyle coach from Netflix's "Queer Eye," launched Kē, a wellness app featuring an AI digital clone of himself to provide personalized guidance on fitness, nutrition, meditation, sobriety, and personal growth. The app applies AI-powered coaching to health and wellness, extending Brown's expertise through scalable digital means.
